name: 32566 · Navarre, FL
findings: ZIP 32566 (Navarre) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32566 (Navarre) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32566 (Navarre) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
